title: Intuitive Surgical Q2 2026 Form 10-Q
excerpt: For the first half of 2026 Intuitive reported USD 5.6631 billion revenue, USD 1.6396 billion attributable net income, 358.5 million diluted shares, USD 419.4 million share-based compensation, and USD 8.6255 billion cash plus investments at June 30.
summary: The Q2 Form 10-Q supplies the current diluted-share, net-financial-asset, stock-compensation, operating-margin and cash-flow inputs required for a scenario-complete mature-compounder valuation.
